results.content: Washington, D.C., April 28, 2026 – This latest Reuters/Ipsos poll, conducted April 24-27, finds that a rising share of Americans say the national economy is off on the wrong track: 61%, up from 43% in January 2025. In addition, a rising share of Americans (20%) say that economic concerns are the most important problem facing the country, up slightly from March (16%). The share selecting war and foreign conflicts as their top concern is down from 14% in March to 8% in April.
